name: 92705 · Santa Ana, CA
findings: ZIP 92705 (Santa Ana) has 309 nonprofit organizations. 126 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 95 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92705 (Santa Ana) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92705 (Santa Ana) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 95 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
